terms_read.summary: DSpace default robots.txt. Disallows /search, /admin/*, /processes, /submit, /workspaceitems, /profile, /workflowitems and facet links on entity pages, and blocks a list of named site-copier bots. The REST API (/server/api) and OAI-PMH (/server/oai) are not disallowed; no Crawl-delay is set. This fetcher uses only OAI-PMH, the REST item/bundle/bitstream endpoints and the bitstream content links, at one request every 3 s.

No site-wide terms page: the DSpace end-user agreement answers 404 and the home page links to none. The home page says the repository distributes SADiLaR's collections, data sets, tools and other language resources. Terms are therefore per item: the licence in each record's dc.rights.license governs it, and is copied into every document taken from it. Items whose bitstreams need a login are skipped, never worked around.
OAI-PMH 2.0 endpoint, admin contact support@sadilar.org; used as the bulk metadata route (6 ListRecords pages) instead of crawling.

selection_rule: dc.media.type = Text; title or category names a monolingual / genre-classification / text corpus; not annotated, parallel, lexicon or speech; licence names CC BY or CC BY-SA and no NC/ND/research-only term; one declared language, not English; access status open.access.
